collectionMethod: Direct capture of the official OpenCode announcement on X (https://x.com/opencode/status/2122969474571583885, posted 2026-11-18T08:25:40Z, quoting phase 2 post 2122763721923559595 from 2026-11-17T18:48:05Z), the official OpenCode Go models API (https://opencode.ai/inference/go/v1/models), the official OpenCode Go documentation page (https://opencode.ai/docs/go/), and the official OpenCode Go landing page (https://opencode.ai/go) on 2026-11-19.
scope: OpenCode Go official per-model monthly allowance boost for GLM-5.3 (model id 'glm-5.3', canonical_id 'zhipuai/glm-5.3'). Following the 2026-11-17 phase 2 boost ($200 for $10), OpenCode announced on 2026-11-18 '$10 for $500 GLM 5.3 till end of the week'. The official models API and landing page reflect Go monthly usage $500 (Go Plus $1,000, Go Teams $505) with three-part token pricing unchanged (input $1.40 / output $4.40 / cached read $0.26 per 1M tokens). The official docs explicitly state: 'GLM-5.3: Higher usage limits apply through November 22, 2026.'
adoptionStatus: adopted (maintainer-requested promo update on 2026-11-19); opencode_go::glm-5.3 updated from $15 (0.485 亿/月) to $500 (16.171 亿/月, real $0.00618391/MTok) in scripts/build_adopted.py OPENCODE_GO_MODELS, with explicit promo expiry 2026-11-22 and recheck required after expiry
recheckTrigger: After 2026-11-22 (end of the week), re-verify https://opencode.ai/inference/go/v1/models and https://opencode.ai/docs/go/ and revert or update opencode_go::glm-5.3 to its post-promo monthly allowance.
